name: Hiiragi Akira
source:
President of the Movie Research Club. He always forces the protagonist into helping him with the movie films. He has a mental list of trivia about almost every girl in the school even though he is "dating" someone from another school, "Male Prudence" he calls it. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/KimiKiss]Wikipedia[/url]]
